name: Ring of Telekinesis

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Telekinesis
powers.text: Cast Telekinesis at will, targeting only objects you aren't wearing or carrying... and creatures as the spell allows.

text: While wearing this ring, you can cast Telekinesis at will, but you can target only objects that aren't being worn or carried.
